headline: Sep 9 PM · Overnight Frankie ran the funnel himself — a test lead (AMANDA, his own email) landed in the CRM at 4:31 AM and then got nothing: no welcome email, an SLA breach 83 minutes later. That is the missing-lead bug reproduced live, and it sits downstream of the form, not in the form-to-sheet handoff we blamed this morning. Meanwhile the $200 tranche is 34% gone ($67.23) on one attributable lead, both real leads still sit out-of-area and untouched, and compliance is 0/7 on day 10.

spotlight.title: The missing-lead bug just reproduced itself live — and it's downstream of the form
spotlight.detail: Overnight Frankie submitted the funnel end-to-end himself: lead AMANDA (his own email, phone …4265) arrived in the CRM at 04:31:59Z, id L-YTCLT0-XC — and W1 never sent the welcome email. flashworkflow flagged "backend did not fire" at 28 minutes and an SLA breach at 83. So the lead DID reach the CRM this time — the break is in W1's completion / welcome-email step, not the V3 form → "Meta $300 Plan Leads" Sheet mapping we named this morning. You have a concrete failing execution to open now. One caution: the 10:08Z watchdog says "backend ran clean, no errors" for the same window flashworkflow says W1 didn't finish — reconcile which is true before you trust either counter.

spotlight.title: A third of the tranche is gone and it is still buying out-of-area leads
spotlight.detail: V2 is day 5 of 10 with $67.23 of $200 spent ($0.72 yesterday, lifetime $312.55) on one attributable lead — and both real leads it has produced, Nadine Dickens (TX, "NO ONE CAN") and Linda Hansink (WA, "OUT OF LICENSED AREA"), are in states you cannot write in and still untouched. Narrow the form/campaign geo to your licensed states today. Every dollar past this point buys the same unusable lead, and the Sep 15 verdict on this tranche is only as honest as the map it was pointed at.

spotlight.title: Compliance 0/7 on day 10 — and a real person breached SLA behind the gate overnight
spotlight.detail: b3 (TX telephone-solicitor registration) and b7 (CA producer license # disclosure) are still open, unchanged since Aug 27. AMANDA sat in the CRM overnight with the system telling you "call them by hand now" while the gate reads 0/7 and two named real people (Nadine, Linda) wait behind it. Spend is trivial right now ($0.72) — this is the cheapest window you will get to close the gates or put the one-line rule in writing about who may be dialed and by whom.

blockers.label: Missing-lead bug reproduced — W1 welcome step, not the form
blockers.detail: AMANDA (Frankie's own overnight test, arrived 04:31:59Z, lead L-YTCLT0-XC) reached the CRM but got no welcome email and SLA-breached at 83 min. The break is downstream of the form, in W1 Lead Ingest's completion. Open that failing execution, fix the welcome step, re-submit to prove. 10:08Z watchdog "backend clean" contradicts flashworkflow "W1 did not finish."

blockers.label: Geo — campaign points at the wrong map
blockers.detail: Both real V2 leads out of licensed area (Nadine Dickens TX, Linda Hansink WA), still untouched. Re-target the form/campaign to licensed states, and decide refer-out-or-drop on both in writing before any contact.

blockers.label: Compliance 0/7
blockers.detail: b3 (TX telephone-solicitor registration, $200 + $10K bond) and b7 (CA producer license #, Cal Ins Code 1725.5(c)) still open on day 10 of live dialing, with a real name (AMANDA) breaching SLA behind the gate overnight.

blockers.label: Day-10 decision has no measurement behind it
blockers.detail: V2 closes at $200 / Sep 15. Booked calls from real ad leads: still zero measured. The lead count is now disputed hour to hour — 09:08Z watchdog "1 lead missing from inbox" vs 10:08Z "every lead reached the inbox." Decide now what evidence would count as "keep going."

blockers.detail: "honest broker - Copy", created overnight, was marked Not Approved by Meta ~2:29 AM PT. It isn't spending, but it won't run until you fix the policy issue or delete it. Low urgency — clear it when you're in Ads Manager for the geo fix.
